known_risks: 中文：2026-08-07 隔离实测否定了旧候选：仅强制 0xC7 检查并把动作倍率改为 2.0，只会看到动作表现加速，整体位移不明显。修正版额外把同一 PPC 水下处理函数的三条坐标积分路径从 0.5 改为 1.0；这是针对 Wii U 行为新增的位移校正，尚未通过修后实机验收。 / English: The 2026-08-07 isolated test rejected the old candidate: forcing effect 0xC7 and changing only the action-rate scalars to 2.0 produced visible action-rate acceleration without clear overall displacement. The correction additionally changes all three coordinate-integration paths in the same PPC underwater handler from 0.5 to 1.0; this Wii U-specific displacement correction still awaits post-fix gameplay verification.

中文：只启用本项并关闭 #65，保持 FPS、武器、模拟摇杆幅度、动作与起终点一致，对同一路线计时至少三次；同时检查碰撞、转向、上浮/下潜是否出现过冲。 / English: Enable only this pack and disable #65; keep FPS, weapon, analog-stick magnitude, action, and route endpoints identical, time the same underwater route at least three times, and also check collision, turning, ascent, and descent for overshoot.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #13 转换为 JP v96 PPC，并根据 2026-08-07 实测补充三条实际水下坐标积分的 0.5→1.0 位移校正；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #13 to JP-v96 PPC and, following the 2026-08-07 gameplay result, adds 0.5-to-1.0 displacement corrections to all three actual underwater coordinate-integration paths; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
